__bicep_exported_variables!.name: namingCatalog
__bicep_exported_variables!.description: Merged runtime catalog, retaining naming rules, diagnostics and null constraints, but excluding bundled provenance and legacy-only metadata. This is not a validation guarantee.

metadata.name: Resource naming
metadata.description:
Pure naming functions using the modern [Terraform naming utility](https://github.com/Azure/terraform-azure-avm-utl-naming) catalog. No resources, telemetry, randomness or name-availability checks are performed.

Import `getName`, `getNames` or `getNamesByResourceType` and pass an options object. Use a nonempty `uniqueSeed` for Terraform-compatible exact tokens, `uniqueLength: 0` for no token, or `uniqueIdentity` with optional `uniqueScope` and `uniqueAttempt` for Bicep-derived tokens. Reuse every input and pin the module version for in-place redeployment; change caller-owned identity for a fresh name. Derived tokens start with a letter, use the full, untruncated logical name and are limited to 13 characters. Catalog descriptions, provenance, resource-type metadata and length limits are not hashed; changes to rendering rules can still change names. Derived tokens are not Terraform random seeds. Hashes can collide; length and name availability remain the caller's responsibility.

Default rendering, prefixes/suffixes, casing, slugs, numbered instances, fixed names and property-level catalog overrides follow Terraform for ASCII inputs. Character counting and Unicode casing use native ARM semantics, which differ from Terraform's Unicode handling. Customer files are loaded by the caller with `loadJsonContent` and passed as `customOverrides`; schema_version and snake-case catalog properties stay unchanged. Omitted properties inherit; explicit values replace, including arrays and whole metadata objects.

Catalog keys are case-sensitive. Batch requests with case-colliding keys return an error for that group, under its lowercase key when supplied. Mis-cased overrides never replace canonical entries. `getCatalog` retains inspectable rules and adds `catalogErrors` to invalid or colliding entries.

Templates support `${token}`, `${lower(token)}`, `${upper(token)}`, joining prefix/suffix lists, and `join(separator, [token, ...])` with optional `compact`. Custom token names must be distinct ignoring case; names that collide with built-in tokens are rejected. Arbitrary HCL expressions, directives, indexing, nested function expressions and the frozen Terraform legacy renderer are not supported. Unsupported syntax returns errors and null names. Instance formats support a single `%d` or `%0Nd` with optional literal text, not arbitrary Terraform format expressions.

UUID entries use native Bicep `guid`, whose namespace differs from Terraform `uuidv5("url", ...)`; UUID values are therefore deliberately not cross-language identical. Literal names cannot retain instance or uniqueness tokens. Always inspect the retention flags before relying on them.

`nameAvailable` means rendering succeeded, not that Azure accepts or has the name available. Validation returns null, never true, when catalog constraints or native regex support are incomplete. Supported anchored ASCII character-class patterns and literals are compiled into validation descriptors without editing the upstream rules; other RE2 patterns (including Unicode classes and new customer patterns) remain explicitly unvalidated. `requireValidNames` rejects both invalid and incompletely validated candidates.

Upstream snapshots under `upstream` are byte-identical at the revision in `catalog-source.json`. Run `. .\utilities\tools\Sync-NamingCatalog.ps1; Sync-NamingCatalog -Check` from the repository root to verify hashes and lossless chunk recomposition. The compact runtime catalog omits bundled `source`, `override_reason`, `override_source`, `legacy_slug` and `legacy_outputs`; inspect the Terraform snapshots for that provenance and legacy-only metadata. All naming rules and validation diagnostics remain. Explicit customer properties are still retained and replace whole properties.

Generated JSON is minified, shares repeated values and packs positional indexes into strings so consumer compilation does not expand them into indented arrays. Each importing template still embeds the catalog and functions; calculate names once and pass strings to child modules when possible. Consumer-size checks enforce a 256 KiB budget for one importer and cover three and ten independent nested consumers against ARM's 4 MiB template limit.

The downstream synchronization workflow reports potential rendering, validation and metadata-only changes and runs native, catalog, documentation and scoped compliance checks before proposing a draft. It does not rely on token-created events starting other checks automatically. Maintainers still review naming changes and choose release versions; the workflow never scrapes Azure rules or merges updates.

This module is under development at the proposed path in [Azure/Azure-Verified-Modules#3059](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Verified-Modules/issues/3059); proposal filing does not establish program approval.
A partial upstream version-2 resource rule. Supplied properties replace earlier properties, rather than recursively merging.
The upstream customer-file shape. Load the file at compile time in the caller; file paths cannot be evaluated inside a naming function.
Optional. Components before the slug. Null and empty components are removed.
Optional. Components after the slug. Null and empty components are removed.
Optional. Exact Terraform-compatible seed, used unchanged before taking uniqueLength characters. Cannot be combined with derived identity inputs.
Optional. Maximum token length. Default 4; zero disables uniqueness. Derived tokens support at most 13 characters.
Optional. Stable caller-owned identity included in token derivation. Change it for a fresh attempt; hash collisions remain possible.
Optional. Caller-owned scope, such as a subscription ID; never discovered implicitly.
Optional. Caller-owned fresh-attempt identity. Omit or reuse for in-place retries.
Optional. Allow digits after the first letter of derived tokens. Default true. Does not alter an explicit uniqueSeed.
Optional. Nonnegative numeric instance. Zero is an explicit instance.
Optional. One %d or %0Nd conversion with literal text. Default %03d. Width is a minimum, not a cap.
Optional. Version-2 customer catalog loaded by the caller. Supplied properties replace generated and manual properties.
Optional. Final slug overrides keyed by catalog key. Null inherits the catalog slug; an empty string omits it.
Optional. Additional string template tokens with ASCII identifier names. Built-in names are reserved regardless of case, except the exact instance token when no numbered instance is supplied.
Optional. Supported Terraform template strings. Null selects the default rendering.
Optional. Return null names unless all supported validation checks succeed. Default false, matching Terraform candidate-name behavior.
Naming inputs. Empty options are valid for base names but require an explicit seed or identity to produce unique names.
